findings.message: This is a verbatim copy of VariableInterval.resolve() from the Task SDK, and the two have already diverged (KeyError here vs AirflowRuntimeError there) while sharing the same user-facing error strings. The parsing/validation half is identical and backend-agnostic — factor it into one helper so a future change to the accepted value format does not have to be made in two places that no test compares.

A bare DeprecationWarning is filtered out by default in Python, so nobody outside the test suite will ever see this, and "a future release" does not commit to a removal version. Please use the project's deprecation warning class and name the target release. This is also a public Task SDK API change (deprecation plus the dropped `> 0` validation) announced only in an airflow-core .bugfix newsfragment — it needs its own newsfragment under task-sdk/newsfragments/.
